mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (username, password, name, role, phone, status, dept_id, student_id, avatar, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{role}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{deptId}, #{studentId}, #{avatar}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select:
select id, username, name, role, phone, status, dept_id, student_id, avatar, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from sys_user
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and role = #{role}
order by create_time desc, id desc
